headline: This is an internal tidy-up of the payment code that should not change what customers see or pay.
what_changed: Nothing new for customers. The checkout page and charging work the same way as before.
When a payment is refused, the error is now a labelled type that can be recognised. The message text customers or staff see stays the same.
The code that builds the payment request was split into smaller pieces. The same security details and the same protection against double charges are still sent.
The checkout code now builds its payment details in a separate helper. The amount, currency, customer and order reference are unchanged.
good_news: The change is small and contained, and it is mostly moving existing code rather than rewriting it.
I checked the only place that starts a payment. It still sends the same amount, currency, customer, description and duplicate-charge protection key.
No other part of the app uses the old error in a way this change could break.
